invariants.rationale: The method returns a List<WriteStatus> as the result after postWrite; postWrite should not return null.
instantTime is used in several subsequent method calls as an identifier, likely required to be set and non-empty.
bulkInsert operations should only occur with a non-null, non-empty record list.
Each WriteStatus typically corresponds to one or more records; result cannot have more entries than input records.
The Option<BulkInsertPartitioner> is expected to be non-null (though it can be Option.empty()).
